title: The posture profile API, SDK and Terraform data source

prose.text: The posture profile API is read-only in every source.

prose.label: Terraform.
prose.text: {{no-tf-resource}} {{tf-lookup}} {{tf-omits-fields}} Id-over-name selection in data sources is in [[zpa.terraform.data-source-selection]], and fields data sources leave unset are in [[zpa.terraform.data-source-fidelity]].

checks.do: Which call reads the object: the v2 list for search and paging, the v1 call for one profile by id.
Whether the task is a read, which all sources support, rather than a write, which none document or implement.
How a profile is found by UDID or by name in the tool being used.
Whether a field the Terraform data source does not export is needed from the SDK instead.

endpoints.statement: The documented posture profile calls are GETs in the posture-profile-controller: all profiles by page on the v2 path, with search, and one profile by id on the v1 path.

quotes: Send a GET request to the following endpoint in the posture-profile-controller: /mgmtconfig/v2/admin/customers/{customerId}/posture.
Send a GET request to the following endpoint in the posture-profile-controller: /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/{customerId}/posture/{id}.

expect.description: Gets all posture profiles for the specified customer.
Gets the configured posture profile for the specified ID.
The search string used to support search by features and fields for the API.

spec-get-only.statement: The captured API specification defines only get operations on its two posture paths, and no operation that creates, changes or deletes a posture profile.

expect.description: Gets all posture profiles for the specified customer.
Gets the configured posture profile for the specified ID.

spec-get-only.conditions: Absence claim from a search of zpa.openapi.json: the two posture paths each define only a get member.

paging.statement: The list call pages with page and pagesize, default page size 20 and maximum 500, and accepts a search string.

expect.description: Specifies the page size. If not provided, the default page size is 20. The max page size is 500.
The search string used to support search by features and fields for the API.

go-functions.statement: The Go SDK's postureprofile package has Get (v1 by id), and GetByPostureUDID, GetByName and GetAll on the v2 list; GetByPostureUDID reads the whole list and compares postureUdid.

quotes: func Get(ctx context.Context, service *zscaler.Service, id string)
func GetByPostureUDID(ctx context.Context, service *zscaler.Service, postureUDID string)
func GetByName(ctx context.Context, service *zscaler.Service, postureName string)

evidence.after: func GetByPostureUDID(ctx context.Context, service *zscaler.Service, postureUDID string)
func GetByName(ctx context.Context, service *zscaler.Service, postureName string)

python-methods.statement: The Python SDK's PostureProfilesAPI has list_posture_profiles(query_params) on the v2 path and get_profile(profile_id), with no query_params argument, on the v1 path.

python-no-lookup.statement: The Python SDK's PostureProfilesAPI has no lookup by name or UDID.
python-no-lookup.conditions: Absence read of posture_profiles.py at the pinned SDK: besides the constructor, list_posture_profiles and get_profile are its only methods; a quote cannot pin the absence of further methods in code.

no-sdk-writes.statement: Neither SDK has a create, update or delete function for posture profiles.
no-sdk-writes.conditions: Absence claim from a read of the Go postureprofile package and the Python posture_profiles.py: the functions in claims go-functions and python-methods are all of them.

no-tf-resource.statement: The Terraform provider registers zpa_posture_profile as a data source only; it has no posture profile resource.
no-tf-resource.conditions: Absence claim from a read of the provider's ResourcesMap in provider.go: no entry names a posture profile resource.

tf-lookup.statement: The zpa_posture_profile data source finds a profile by id when one is given and otherwise by name; posture_udid is exported, and the read ignores it as input.
tf-lookup.conditions: Wording changed: posture_udid is Optional and Computed in the schema, but the read never uses it as input.

tf-omits-fields.statement: The zpa_posture_profile data source has no postureType, platform, rootCert or boolean-flag attributes: its schema and its d.Set calls cover only id, name, posture_udid, domain, master_customer_id, zscaler_cloud, zscaler_customer_id and the time and modified-by fields.
tf-omits-fields.conditions: Absence claim from a read of data_source_zpa_posture_profile.go: neither its schema nor its flatten calls name posture_type, platform, root_cert or the three flags, which the SDK object holds.
